units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 9:2">Shebi. IX, 2</cite> <he>וביהודה ההר הש׳ וכ׳</he> in Judæa, (the three districts are) the highland, the lowland, and the valley; <he>ושְׁפֵלַת לוד כשפלת הדרום</he> and the lowland of Lydda is (with reference to Sabbatical year laws) like the lowland of Darom (South). Tosef. ib. VII, 10; Y. ib. IX, 38ᵈ bot. <he>שָׁפֵל ושְׁפֵלָתוֹ</he> (not <he>שפלה</he>), v. <cite ref="P00920"><he>עֵמֶק</he></cite>. Ib. <he>מאמאוס עד לוד ש׳</he> from Emmaus to Lydda is the plain (of Judæa). Ib. <he>לש׳ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="O00710"><he>סימן</he></cite>) the presence of sycamores indicates lowland; <cite ref="Pesachim 53a">Pes. 53ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
